board.title: Consistency board
board.subtitle: A weekly ranking of how regularly you log. Not about body weight.
board.notRanked: You are not on this week's board yet. Log a meal first.
board.consent: The board shows your name or alias, days logged, workout days, protein days and your streak. Body weight and body data are never shown. You can leave any time, and your board data is deleted with it.
board.streakNote: The streak on badges and the board counts valid logged days (with calories, written within 2 days of the day), so it can differ from the flame on Home.
board.maternal: The board is not available during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
board.aliasHint: {{min}}-{{max}} characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash.
board.optInBody: See where you stand each week. Only your name or alias and your logging counts are shown, never body weight.
board.emptyHint: Be the first: join from Privacy.
board.noGroups: You are not in a group yet.
board.privacyNote: The board is optional and off by default.
board.optOutNote: Leaving deletes your data from the board.
